sources.title: Qwen/Qwen3-4B-MLX-4bit — AICHINA.news | AI China News
sources.snippet: Qwen3-4B-MLX-4bit is a compact large language model from Alibaba's latest Qwen3 series, specifically optimised for Apple Silicon using the MLX framework. It features a unique architecture that allows developers to toggle between a 'thinking mode' for complex logical reasoning and a 'non-thinking mode' for fast, general-purpose dialogue within a single 4-billion parameter model.
